test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people—A, B, C, D, E, and F—are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). A is an immediate neighbour of both E and F. C is second to the left of F. B is not is an immediate neighbour of E. What is the position of D?

options.text: Second to the right of B

solution:
**Given: **Six people—A, B, C, D, E, and F—are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

​1) A is an immediate neighbour of both E and F.

2) C is second to the left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1b21fee9f55d2da3e3dde2238bbe6290da82581e035d167eac9f240ecf45fa3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/816ac07755ab7c6352dba01f58478f2208d4bc364035f358b13923695b0cc214.png] 

3) B is not is an immediate neighbour of E.

After positioning B only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba07b99988669dd183f02dc8e88e286a06ebef1d1f8724d3513b87d1bbdb67f0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5f436dc071cecd1cc8f347530f376eaa84d4a02387bbfae8d7995326b7ef9ee.png] 

Thus, D is sitting to the immediate left of C.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
